key_insight: Exact blockwise references reveal local covariance loss in QAOA hardware results that aggregate energy improvements can conceal.
engineering_relevance: Check encoding feasibility and benchmark structure before choosing hardware diagnostics, since lower energy alone can overstate useful circuit performance.
method: Compare the executed 24-qubit surrogate with a faithful 51-qubit slack encoding.
Exploit 13 support-graph components for exact blockwise simulation.
Compare measured weighted covariance with ideal references and a product-distribution baseline.
evidence_signal: Across three fixed-circuit jobs, the global weighted-covariance ratio was approximately 0.50 versus 0.12–0.28 in a five-variable block, while measured bit marginals explained about 90% of the observed energy reduction.
watch_item: The exploratory conditional counting analysis identifies a local discrepancy but neither establishes its error mechanism nor demonstrates device stability.
paper_title: Classical simulability and hardware diagnostics for QAOA on geographic coverage benchmarks
